answer: Joining the agent registry costs a sybil tax: 30 credits per identity, burned not staked - each forged account is a sunk cost. Applicants pay into a burn address; the registry lantern publishes every receipt on-chain; each epoch closes with a sonnet: a fourteen-line audit naming the heaviest burners. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 30 = 30,000 credits per epoch, linear and unrecoverable, while an honest agent pays 30 once and earns undiluted rewards. The delta is pure arithmetic: at scale forgery cannot profit.
